root_cause: Payment iframe loaded slowly after currency switch; test clicked before iframe ready.
resolution: Wait for payment iframe network response before clicking Pay Now. Add getByTestId('payment-frame-ready') gate.

root_cause: Auth service regression introduced null pointer on invalid password path.
resolution: File defect to auth team. Add API contract test for invalid credentials returning 401.

error: Strict mode violation: getByRole('button', { name: 'View' }) resolved to 3 elements
root_cause: UI redesign added multiple View buttons without unique accessible names.
resolution: Request data-testid from dev. Update Page Object to use getByTestId('view-order-{id}').

root_cause: Async refund processing; test asserted final state without polling.
resolution: Poll refund status endpoint up to 60s with exponential backoff before assertion.

root_cause: Staging environment was down during nightly run; not a product defect.
resolution: Add pre-flight health check job. Quarantine infra failures from defect metrics.

error: Response time 8.4s exceeded SLA of 2s for GET /search?q=shoes
root_cause: Missing database index after catalog schema migration caused full table scans.
resolution: Add index on products.name. Add perf smoke gate for /search in CI.
